stem_book: A uniform rod of length L and mass M lies on a smooth horizontal table. A particle of mass m moving on the table with speed v strikes the rod perpendicularly at one end and sticks to the rod after the collision. Find the velocity of the rod with respect to C (the centre of mass of rod + particle) before the collision.
correct_answer: −mv/(M + m) (i.e. mv/(M + m) opposite to the particle's motion)
